too_hard.title: It feels too hard
too_hard.desc: The lessons or exercises are more than I can handle right now.

no_time.title: I don't have time
no_time.desc: Life is busy and I can't fit in my usual study time.

need_rest.title: I need a rest
need_rest.desc: I'm tired or overloaded and I want a break.

distracted.title: I get distracted
distracted.desc: I can start, but it is hard to stay focused.

stuck.title: What is making it hard?
stuck.lead: Stopping is okay. It happens to every learner. We only want to understand, not to push you.
stuck.promise: Nothing in your plan changes until you say so.
stuck.minutes_label: About how many minutes do you have today? (optional)
stuck.minutes_hint: Between 5 and 240. We use it to suggest a daily study time that fits.
stuck.note_label: Anything you would like to add? (optional)
stuck.note_hint: A private note, up to 500 characters. It is not used to work out suggestions and is never sent to an AI service.
stuck.open_proposal: You already have a suggestion waiting for your decision.
stuck.rest_link: Just want to rest? Take a break now

summary.too_hard: You said things feel too hard right now. That is normal when learning Mandarin and says nothing bad about you. Below are a few gentle ways to lighten the load, based on your plan and your recent answers. Take what helps and leave the rest.
summary.no_time: You said you do not have enough time right now. That is fair: a plan only helps if it fits your life. Below are a few ways to make it smaller. Take what helps and leave the rest.
summary.need_rest: You said you need a rest. That is a good reason to stop and you do not have to explain it. Below is a short break you can accept, or you can keep your plan exactly as it is.
summary.distracted: You said it is hard to stay focused. That happens to everyone. Below are small changes that make a session easier to finish. Take what helps and leave the rest.
summary.default: Below are a few gentle suggestions based on your plan. Take what helps and leave the rest.

item_title.split_session: Split your study into shorter sessions
item_title.review_topic: Go over a tricky topic again

item.split_session: Split your daily study into {sessions} shorter sessions (now: {old}).
item.split_session_plain: Split your daily study into {sessions} shorter sessions.
item.pomodoro: Study in focused blocks of {minutes} minutes, with a short break between blocks.
item.take_rest: Rest for {days} days. No study is expected, and you can come back earlier whenever you like.
item.take_rest_one: Rest for 1 day. No study is expected, and you can come back earlier whenever you like.
item.review_topic: Practise “{topic}” a little more over the next week.
item.unknown: A suggestion that this version of the app cannot describe.

evidence.accuracy: In the last {days} days you answered {correct} of {total} {skill} questions correctly.
evidence.few_data_zero: We have no {skill} answers from you yet, so we cannot say how it is going and we will not guess.
evidence.few_data_one: We have only 1 {skill} answer from you so far. That is too few to say how it is going, so we show no percentage.
evidence.few_data: We have only {total} {skill} answers from you so far. That is too few to say how it is going, so we show no percentage.
evidence.weak_topic: In the last {days} days you missed {wrong} questions on “{topic}”.
evidence.completion: In the last {days} days you finished {done} of {scheduled} daily tasks.
evidence.available_minutes: You said you have about {value} minutes today.
evidence.plan_at_minimum: Your plan is already at its lightest, so a rest is the only gentler option left.

field.rest_until: Rest: your next study day is {new}

proposal.title: Here is what we found
proposal.notice: Nothing has changed yet. Your plan only changes if you confirm.
proposal.ai_note: Written by an AI chosen by the operator. The suggestions below and every number come from fixed rules, and only the ones you tick are applied. If this wording and the list below ever differ, the list is what counts.
proposal.items_hint: Tick the ones you want. Nothing is ticked for you.
proposal.manual: Prefer to set the numbers yourself? Edit your plan
proposal.outcome_accepted: You accepted all of this suggestion.
proposal.outcome_partial: You accepted part of this suggestion.
proposal.outcome_rejected: You chose to keep your plan as it was.
proposal.outcome_superseded: A newer suggestion, or a change you made to your plan, replaced this one.
proposal.ask_again: Tell us how it is going now
proposal.stale_title: Your plan has changed since this suggestion was made
proposal.stale_body: The numbers here were worked out from an older version of your plan, so we cannot apply them. Nothing was changed. A fresh suggestion only takes a moment.
proposal.open_other: You have a newer suggestion waiting.

done.title_rejected: Your plan stays as it was
done.rest_chosen: You chose to rest. Your next study day is {date}.
done.rejected: You decided to keep your current plan. Nothing was changed, and that is perfectly fine.
done.partial_note: You chose some of the suggestions. The rest were left out.
done.superseded: This suggestion was replaced before you decided, so nothing was applied.
done.again: Tell us how it is going now

feedback.title: How was this? (optional)
feedback.lead: This is about our suggestion, not about you. Your answers help us keep it light.
feedback.thanks: Thank you. Your feedback is already saved.

rest.title: Take a rest
rest.lead: Rest is part of learning. Choose how long you need. You do not have to explain, and you can come back whenever you like.
rest.status_days: You are resting. Your next study day is {date}.
rest.status_open: You are resting until you come back.
rest.resume_hint: Your plan is exactly as you left it.
rest.legend: How long would you like to rest?
rest.until_back_desc: No end date. Press “I'm back” when you are ready.
rest.note: Resting does not change your plan.

plan.title: Your study plan
plan.own: This is your plan. You can raise or lower any number whenever you like. Suggestions from us are always optional.
plan.review_title: Topics you are going over again
plan.pending: You have a suggestion waiting for your decision.
plan.save_hint: Saving closes any open suggestion, because its numbers would no longer match.
